title: 第一章 脑力进化者第二章 能力测试
content_zh:
东夏联邦。
魔都一号线。
“呜~~~~”
急速行驶的地铁在甬道穿梭，引发气流摩擦。
相对安静的车厢里，林夜抱着书包，正倚靠在角落和母亲小声通话。
“小夜，别给自己太大压力，实在找不到工作，就回老家来，咱家的小超市也能挣够吃的。”
“嗯，我知道了，妈你放心吧，医生说我没事。”
简单聊了几句，林夜挂断电话，熟悉的疲惫再次涌入脑海，昏昏沉沉，让他有种就地躺下的想法。
“又来了...”
林夜颇为无奈。
这一世的自己一向很健康，更是凭借着两世宿慧，考上了蓝星魔都大学。
本来日子好好的，谁曾想，眼看快要毕业了，他突然开始经常犯困起来。
不是普通的困倦，而是那种毫无理由的犯困，哪怕前一天晚上睡得再好，第二天刚刚苏醒也有可能立刻犯困。
最严重的时候，他甚至在操场跑步中直接摔倒昏厥。
林夜很慌，他的美好人生才刚刚开始，要是得了脑科病那还不亏死？
所以今天他趁着周末，专门花高价，从黄牛手里买了魔都公立医院顶级的脑科专家号。
结果一通检查之后，专家居然说他根本没有任何问题。
林夜更慌了。
因为...检查不到问题的问题，才是真的问题。
前方座椅上两个中学生正捧着手机看的出神，嘴里还在不断的讨论着什么。

“卧槽，真的假的？这人竟然可以控制水！”
“一眼ai！”
“可这是直播啊，还是在户外，还有这么多人看着...”
“都是演员，八十一天还管饭。”
“咦？直播间怎么封了？”
“肯定是被人举报了呗。用ai就用ai，非要说自己觉醒了超能力，难道他不知道建国后不许成精？”
“那一个月前的大雾怎么解释？”
“联邦都说了，是全球变暖。”
“次次都说全球变暖，能不能有点新意？”
两人的争吵，将林夜的思绪带入一个月前。
那一天，整个东夏联邦，不对，应该说是整个世界，都被一场大雾笼罩。
content_en:
Eastern Xia Federation.
Magic City Line 1.
"Woo~~~~"
The fast-moving subway shuttles in the corridor, causing airflow friction.
In the relatively quiet carriage, Lin Ye was leaning in the corner and talking quietly to his mother, holding his schoolbag.
"Xiaoye, don't put too much pressure on yourself. If you really can't find a job, just come back to your hometown. We can earn enough food in our small supermarket."
"Well, I understand. Don't worry, Mom. The doctor said I'm fine."
After a brief chat, Lin Ye hung up the phone. The familiar exhaustion flooded into his mind again, making him feel dizzy, making him want to lie down on the spot.
"Here we go again..."
Lin Ye was quite helpless.
In this life, I have always been very healthy, and with the wisdom of two lives, I was admitted to Blue Star Magic City University.
His life was going well, but who would have thought that when he was about to graduate, he suddenly started to feel sleepy often.
It is not ordinary sleepiness, but the kind of sleepiness that has no reason. Even if you sleep well the night before, you may feel sleepy immediately when you wake up the next day.
At the worst time, he even fell down and fainted while running on the playground.
Lin Ye was panicking. His beautiful life had just begun. If he got a brain disease, wouldn't he die?
So today, he took advantage of the weekend to spend a high price to buy the top brain specialist account of the Shanghai Public Hospital from scalpers.
After a thorough examination, the expert actually said that there was nothing wrong with him at all.
Lin Ye was even more panicked.
Because...the problem that cannot be detected is the real problem.
Two middle school students on the seat in front were holding their mobile phones and looking at each other in trance, still discussing something in their mouths.
"Holy shit, is it true? This man can actually control water!"
"One glance ai!"
"But this is a live broadcast, it's still outdoors, and there are so many people watching..."
"They are all actors, but they still manage the food for eighty-one days."
"Huh? Why is the live broadcast room blocked?"
"He must have been reported. If you use AI, use AI. If you insist on saying that you have awakened superpowers, doesn't he know that becoming a spirit is not allowed after the founding of the People's Republic of China?"
"How do you explain the heavy fog a month ago?"
"The federal government has said it's global warming."
"Global warming has been talked about every time, can there be something new?"
The quarrel between the two brought Lin Ye's thoughts back to a month ago.
That day, the entire Eastern Xia Federation, no, it should be said that the entire world, was shrouded in a heavy fog.
